overview.name: Canary HBAR ETF
overview.description: In seeking to achieve the investment objective, the Trust will hold the fund and will value its net assets and the Shares daily based on the Pricing Benchmark. HBAR will be the only digital asset held by the Trust. The Pricing Benchmark is a U.S. dollar-denominated composite reference rate for the price of the fund.
